about.title: About OBUMSJ
about.text1: ODA BULTUM UNIVERSITY MUSLIM STUDENTS' JAMA'A (OBUMSJ) is dedicated to supporting Muslim students in their academic and spiritual journey. Our organization provides various services and programs to help students thrive in their university experience while maintaining their Islamic values.
about.text2: We aim to create a supportive community where students can grow spiritually, academically, and socially while upholding to teachings of Islam.
vision.title: Our Vision
vision.text: To be a leading Muslim student community that fosters spiritual growth, academic excellence, and social responsibility, preparing members to become ethical leaders who contribute positively to society.
mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: To provide a supportive environment for Muslim students to practice their faith, excel in their studies, and engage in community service through various programs, activities, and sectors that address their spiritual, academic, and social needs.
sectors.title: Our Sectors
sectors.subtitle: Explore our 10 dedicated sectors serving the Muslim student community
sector.qirat_desc: Teaching and promoting the beautiful recitation of the Holy Quran through specialized programs and competitions.
sector.dawah_desc: Spreading the message of Islam through various outreach programs, seminars, and community engagement.
sector.social_desc: Addressing social issues and providing support to students through counseling and community services.
sector.academy_desc: Educational programs and Islamic studies for students to enhance their knowledge and skills.
sector.finance_desc: Managing organization funds, donations, and financial activities to support various programs.
sector.ziyara_desc: Organizing visits to Islamic historical sites and facilitating spiritual journeys for students.
sector.ruqiya_desc: Providing spiritual healing through Quranic recitation and Islamic practices for wellbeing.
sector.charity_desc: Managing charitable activities, zakat distribution, and support for needy students and community.
sector.dawrul_desc: Promoting continuous good deeds and sustainable charitable projects for long-term impact.
sector.information_desc: Managing communication, media presence, and information dissemination for the organization.

ruqiya.audio1_desc: This Ruqiya contains verses for protection from evil eye, envy, and harmful magic. Recite with faith and trust in Allah.
ruqiya.audio2_desc: Daily protection supplications for morning and evening as prescribed by Prophet Muhammad (PBUH).
ruqiya.audio3_desc: Quranic verses and supplications for healing from physical and spiritual illnesses. Play for those in need of cure.
ruqiya.audio4_desc: Special Ruqiya for protecting your home and family from evil spirits and negative energies.
ruqiya.verse1_trans: In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful. [All] praise is [due] to Allah, Lord of the worlds. The Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful. Sovereign of the Day of Recompense. It is You we worship and You we ask for help. Guide us to the straight path. The path of those upon whom You have bestowed favor, not of those who have evoked [Your] anger or of those who are astray.
ruqiya.verse2_trans: Say, 'He is Allah, [who is] One. Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born. Nor is there to Him any equivalent.'
ruqiya.verse3_trans: Say, 'I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak. From the evil of that which He created. And from the evil of darkness when it settles. And from the evil of the blowers in knots. And from the evil of an envier when he envies.'
ruqiya.verse4_trans: Say, 'I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind. The Sovereign of mankind. The God of mankind. From the evil of the retreating whisperer. Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind. From among the jinn and mankind.'

about_page.page_title: About Us | OBUMSJ - Oda Bultum University Muslim Students' JAMA'A
about_page.hero_subtitle: We are a Muslim student community dedicated to spiritual growth, academic excellence, and social responsibility. Our mission is to build ethical leaders who serve society with knowledge, faith, and integrity.
about_page.who_text: Our community is a student-based Islamic union that provides religious guidance, academic support, and social activities for Muslim students. We aim to create a strong brotherhood and sisterhood environment where members grow spiritually, intellectually, and socially.
about_page.vision_text: To be a leading Muslim student community that nurtures faith, knowledge, and leadership, producing responsible individuals who positively impact society.
about_page.mission_text: To provide Islamic education, academic support, social services, and leadership training through organized programs and departments.
about_page.history_2015: Community founded by Muslim students to strengthen faith and unity.
about_page.history_2018: Established 5 official departments and launched weekly programs.
about_page.history_2022: Expanded to 9 sectors and started charity and outreach projects.
about_page.history_2026: Launched official website and digital management system.
about_page.constitution_text: You can download our official constitution and bylaws document.
